text:
```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Claude Code
        run: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code

      - name: Run Claude Issue Triage
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
        run: |
          claude \
            --mcp-config '{"mcpServers": {"github": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@anthropic/mcp-github"]}}}' \
            --print \
            --output-format text \
            <<'EOF'
            You are an expert GitHub issue triager. Analyze the following issue and apply appropriate labels.
            
            Issue Title: $ISSUE_TITLE
            Issue Body: $ISSUE_BODY
            
            Available labels: bug, feature, documentation, question, enhancement, good first issue, help wanted
            
            Instructions:
            1. Read the issue carefully
            2. Determine the most appropriate label(s) from the available options
            3. Use the GitHub MCP server to apply the labels to issue number $ISSUE_NUMBER
            4. Add a comment explaining your triage decision
            
            Apply the labels using the GitHub MCP tools.
            EOF
```
